name: Year-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression from the first day of the current year through the latest visible date.

name: Quarter-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression from the first day of the current quarter through the latest visible date.

name: Month-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression from the first day of the current month through the latest visible date.

name: Moving annual total
purpose: Evaluates an expression for the 12-month window ending on the latest visible date.

name: Previous year
purpose: Evaluates an expression in the current date context shifted back one year.

name: Previous quarter
purpose: Evaluates an expression in the current date context shifted back one quarter.

name: Previous month
purpose: Evaluates an expression in the current date context shifted back one month.

name: Previous year complete
purpose: Evaluates an expression for the complete calendar year before the current year.

name: Previous quarter complete
purpose: Evaluates an expression for the complete quarter before the current quarter.

name: Previous month complete
purpose: Evaluates an expression for the complete month before the current month.

name: Previous period
purpose: Selects the previous month, quarter, or year according to hierarchy scope.

name: Previous year moving annual total
purpose: Evaluates the comparable 12-month window ending one year before the latest visible date.

name: Year-over-year
purpose: Returns growth versus the comparable date context one year earlier.

name: Quarter-over-quarter
purpose: Returns growth versus the comparable date context one quarter earlier.

name: Month-over-month
purpose: Returns growth versus the comparable date context one month earlier.

name: Moving annual total growth
purpose: Returns growth between the current moving annual total and the comparable prior-year window.

name: Period-over-period
purpose: Returns growth versus the previous month, quarter, or year according to hierarchy scope.

name: Previous year-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression through the corresponding elapsed point in the prior year.

name: Previous quarter-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression through the corresponding elapsed point in the prior quarter.

name: Previous month-to-date
purpose: Evaluates an expression through the corresponding elapsed point in the prior month.

name: Year-over-year-to-date
purpose: Returns growth between current period-to-date and the corresponding prior period-to-date.

name: Quarter-over-quarter-to-date
purpose: Returns growth between current period-to-date and the corresponding prior period-to-date.

name: Month-over-month-to-date
purpose: Returns growth between current period-to-date and the corresponding prior period-to-date.

name: Year-to-date over previous year
purpose: Returns growth between the current period-to-date and the complete immediately preceding period.

name: Quarter-to-date over previous quarter
purpose: Returns growth between the current period-to-date and the complete immediately preceding period.

name: Month-to-date over previous month
purpose: Returns growth between the current period-to-date and the complete immediately preceding period.
